title: Passenger-side door and front seat mentions
summary: This topic centers on front passenger-side doors, trim, lighting, and seat-area mentions, with many fragments too brief or descriptive to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive comments highlight an easy-to-reach passenger-door handle and a conveniently placed button for opening the passenger door.

negative.summary: Negative comments describe rattling front-door light bars and exterior damage on the front passenger side, with limited examples of clearly negative feedback.

mixed.summary: The mixed feedback combines a problem with the driver/passenger assist handle and discomfort from the location affecting left-leg resting position.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly mention passenger-side doors, controls, locks, lights, seat position, or trim without enough context to judge whether the overall feedback is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined or highly abbreviated, which limits confidence about concrete themes beyond passenger-side location references.
The cluster mixes several subtopics such as door controls, door lighting, trim, seat movement, and exterior damage rather than one single coherent issue.
Some examples with assigned sentiment contain fragment text that is incomplete or sentiment-ambiguous, so the evidence only supports narrow, concrete descriptions.
